rows.grounds: numeral element forming a compound with the following noun
locative plural indicating the vast number
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device) in locative plural
past passive participle describing those subjected to affliction

items.question: Within what vast multitude of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number involved is eighty-four thousand.
These are womb-mechanisms or sources of birth.
items.inference: Beings suffer affliction across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the tormented beings is implied from context rather than stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
